page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top, text in one main column on the left, with marginal notes in a narrow column on the right. Below the text: a catchword "Hacte-" at the right foot.

main_text.p: quodammodo humida, cum ficco terreo compacta.
Contraria est Infecabilitas propter duritiem vel fluorem.
Fissilitas, propter quam corpus in partes longas divisibile est, ut in quo est pororum longitudo, mediocris ariditas, & lentoris vacuitas: Contraria infissilitas.Fissilitas.
Totalem corporis dissolutione spectat Flammabilitas & Exhalabilitas.

Flammabilitas est, propter quam corpus flammae recipiendae capax est, & bustile. In hoc vel ficci terrei copia est, ut in lignis: vel aërei humidi, cum ficco terreo, & humido aqueo permistio, ut in bitumine. Contraria est Inflammabilitas.Flammabilitas.
Exhalabilitas est, propter quam corpus aliquod in vapores resolvi potest, ut quod plurimum habet humiditatis.Exhalabilitas.
main_text.head: Caput Octavum. DE VISIBILIBVS QVALITATIBVS, LVCE ET Coloribus.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are small italic keywords; the faint show-through text at the top left and in the middle is not printed text on this page and was left out. Heading is printed in a decorated initial "D" and italic. The "Q" in "QVALITATIBVS" and "Coloribus" are set in the heading style as printed. Catchword "Hacte-" is the start of the next page's first word.
